entities.name: National Film School in Łódź
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Polish National Film, Television and Theatre School in Łódź, commonly known as the Łódź Film School, is a Polish film school for future directors, actors, cinematographers, producers, animators, photographers, editors and scriptwriters of both cinema and television. It was founded on 8 March 1948 in Łódź (Lodz).
